_doc: Data of graph.rtcfg and graph.rtbox: the runtime-signal mode. limits: what ONE run of the project's tests may use inside the bubblewrap box of the execution target (prlimit: cpu_s, as_mb address space, fsize_mb one file, nofile, nproc; wall_s = the whole box, all runs together; a [graph.runtime] timeout above it is cut). A language may override: as_mb 0 = no address-space limit (V8 and the Go runtime reserve far more virtual memory than they use, so RLIMIT_AS kills them at start; their memory is bounded by `env` below instead). timeouts: default_s of [graph.runtime] timeout, setup_s the extra seconds the controlling side waits beyond it (unpack, tracer reports), put_s / pull_s of the two ssh transfers. refresh_days: how old a stored run may be before it is run again. keep_runs: stored runtime runs kept per repository. result: caps on what comes back (bytes of the result file, symbols, notes). copy: caps on the project copy (tracked files at HEAD) that goes to the target. tracers: per graph language (data/langs.json): the tracer name, the `default_command` run when [graph.runtime] has no command (null = no safe default: the project must say), and the per-language `limits` and `env` of the box. The python tracer is shipped with the tool (stdlib only: sys.monitoring, sys.setprofile before 3.12), so nothing has to be installed on the target for it; node uses NODE_V8_COVERAGE (TypeScript is not traced: source maps are not applied), go injects -coverprofile into `go test` and reads `go tool cover -func`. A language without a tracer is one `no tracer for <lang>` line. classes: per language which checks EXECUTE the project's code (only on the target, in its box) and which only READ it (may run on this machine); a build tool that runs plugins or scripts (maven, gradle, cargo build.rs, MSBuild targets, make) is executing, a parser is not.

classes._doc: executing = runs the project's code (tests, scripts, plugins, build.rs): ONLY on the execution target, in its sandbox. reading = parses or type-checks, runs none of it: may run on the this machine. A language that is not listed has no local check that this mode allows.

python.executing: tests or the configured command under the shipped tracer
python.reading: ast parse and py_compile, in a bubblewrap box

go.executing: go test -coverprofile (the tests and every init())
go.reading: go build and go vet, offline: GOFLAGS=-mod=mod GOPROXY=off

javascript.executing: node tests under NODE_V8_COVERAGE, npm scripts
javascript.reading: none (a syntax check is the parser of the graph)

typescript.executing: no tracer: tests run as JavaScript

java.executing: maven and gradle (their plugins run); no tracer
java.reading: none that is safe: javac annotation processors run

rust.executing: cargo build, check, clippy and test (build.rs, proc-macros run)
rust.reading: none: rustc parsing alone is not offered

csharp.executing: dotnet and MSBuild (targets and analyzers run)
